description: Map a real existing coverage report onto the graph. If no report exists, return clearly labelled static test reachability (a test imports/reaches a source file) with actualCoverage=NOT_AVAILABLE; reachability is never presented as measured coverage.

output_format.description: text returns only the concise TextContent summary; json also returns and mirrors the stable structuredContent envelope

path.description: Optional repo-relative path prefix filter, e.g. src/query

top_n.description: Max risk hotspots to list, default 15

name: coverage_map
